faq.q: Why do I feel bad when I make a mistake?
faq.a: Your brain does not like getting things wrong, so it sends an uncomfortable feeling. That feeling is normal, and it fades once you see the mistake as a clue for learning.
asks: Why do I hate getting things wrong?

faq.q: How do I learn from a mistake?
faq.a: Stop and look at what happened. Ask what went wrong and what you could change, then try again in a new way. Asking a teacher for a hint helps too.
asks: What should I do after a mistake?

faq.q: Does my brain really grow when I learn from mistakes?
faq.a: When you practise and fix mistakes, the connections between your brain cells get stronger and faster. That is how skills like reading and riding a bike become easy.

faq.q: What if everyone laughs at my mistake?
faq.a: It can feel embarrassing, but everyone makes mistakes, including the people laughing. Take a breath, smile, and keep going. A kind teacher or friend will help.
asks: I am scared people will laugh at me

faq.q: What famous things were discovered by mistake?
faq.a: Penicillin, a medicine that kills germs, was found when Alexander Fleming noticed mould on a dish he had left out. Sticky notes came from a glue that was not sticky enough.

facts: Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin in 1928 after noticing mould growing on a dish he had left out.
Sticky notes came from a weak glue made by scientist Spencer Silver in 1968, when he was trying to make a strong one.

quiz.say: What is the best thing to do after a mistake?
quiz.show: What is the best thing to do after a mistake?

options.show: Look at what went wrong and try again
options.say: Look at what went wrong and try again

quiz.why: Mistakes are clues; looking closely and trying again is how you learn.

wrong.0: Hiding a mistake stops you, and others, from helping you fix it.
wrong.2: Giving up means you miss the learning.

quiz.say: When you were learning to walk, what did falling down do?
quiz.show: When you were learning to walk, what did falling down do?

options.show: Taught your body how to balance
options.say: Taught your body how to balance

quiz.why: Each fall gave your brain and body information, until walking became easy.

wrong.1: You can walk now, so the falls did not stop you.
wrong.2: Every fall helped your body learn balance.
